item.tib: dbal gsas rngam pa'i gtor zlog lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnad zlog
item.coloph: dgongs rgyud rig 'dzin gong ma gsum gyi mdos bdag phyi rabs dus kyi tha ma la/ (gong ma) gsum gyi bka'i byin rlabs kyis/ srid pa'i rgyal (mo) la bka' gnang / skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog phyi nas nyi zer bzhin du rgyas par shog ces gsungs nas smon lam btab nas gter du sbas so/ gter bdag srid pa'i rgyal mo dang rma gnyen pom ra las sogs rtse bla bcu gsum la gtad/ bdud srin ru tra gdug pa can rnams dang / dun rtse'i lag tu ma shor bar bka' gtad do/ drag po'i gtor ma byad sna gdug pa can dang zlog pa 'di/ srid pa'i rgyal mo'i (mos) lung bstan/ gnyen po g.yu rtse'i thugs kar nas byung ba'i khro gnyer la gnang / srid pa las kyi gzhung bzhin bod yig zangs dmar la bkod/ phyi rabs dus kyi bstan pa srung par (bar) mdzod//
